rules: Existing AU pilot #1811 and pass 2 #1965: gazetted populated place -> locality / 3; VIC/WA locality; QLD unique active SUB -> suburb, LOCB -> locality; otherwise Geoscape Gazetted Locality -> gazetted locality.
Code-bound: one literal live own SAL code, exact name/state, strict stored-point containment in that SAL, no competing row owner; apply 2021 G01 count regardless old gap.
Boundary-bound: unique exact same-name SAL/locality in state, strict stored-point containment, no competing owner or conflicting own item; count only with max(old,new) <= 1.5 * min(old,new).

Legal register supplies the class; SAL 2021 supplies the accepted code-route point boundary and population scope. SAL approximation and AUG26 legal boundary can differ; both containment results retained.
All city-centre rows held unless an exactly scoped unit exists. No point, name, identifier or parent edits.
